# windows/home/pages/operations/
The operations page: Local onboarding, Hindsight activation, the memory authority / Hindsight operations card, manual memory maintenance,
the memory/context status card, and storage usage with the D46 attachment purge. Every number comes from a WS read — the page computes nothing the Core owns.
- operations-page.tsx — page root: authority, repeated transitions/emergency recovery, Local onboarding, first Hindsight activation, API configuration observation, template/user management, tidy, status and storage cards.
- hindsight-configuration-card.tsx — Global/Character selector and desired-versus-permitted API configuration table; explicit observe/status actions, partial coverage, aliases, refusal and unknown states.
- hindsight-configuration-state.ts — closed configuration reason/profile labels and Core-computed comparison formatting; no health/readiness inference.
- hindsight-configuration-controller.ts — disposable selected-scope/client generations, serialized bounded reads, old-response rejection and one Core status read per evidence expiry; failures clear prior comparisons.
- use-hindsight-configuration.ts — visible Operations/client binding plus focus and document visibility status revalidation; no observation replay or browser persistence.
- use-configuration-characters.ts — current-generation roster for configuration scope selection, with an explicit failed-list retry.
- hindsight-configuration-browser-fixture.ts — test-only disposable authenticated WS fixture using the real Core observation service/client and exact method registry; no model calls or installed Native.
- hindsight-template-card.tsx — Core-listed Bank/default scope, independent selected/latest user revisions, explicit editing, preview and original-plan status.
- hindsight-template-state.ts — safe closed labels, catalog/saved-user draft seeding and current-versus-historical derived wording; consent identity tracks Core connection, setup/Bank roster and generation changes without treating cursor progress as drift.
- hindsight-template-controller.ts — disposable preview/detail/child generations over the common operation owner, exact-once confirmation, preserved drafts and Core-advertised recovery.
- use-hindsight-templates.ts — visible Operations/shared-client lifecycle and focus/visibility status refresh; reconnect restores only the selected child read and never replays a write.
- hindsight-template-editor.tsx — scope version selection and explicit value/inherit/suppress text choices above the template/base.
- hindsight-template-resource-editor.tsx — validated complete resource editing, explicit reset/suppression and an unfinished-form preview gate.
- hindsight-template-resource-form.tsx — complete label/model/directive fields with preserved advanced definitions and duplicate/identity validation.
- hindsight-template-preview.tsx — every Bank's exact old/new definitions, deletion/provider consequences, reviewed enrollment and one consumed confirmation with keyboard dismissal.
- hindsight-template-plan.tsx — separate receipt, selection publication, runtime and original-operation results; current child observations never replace historical records.
- hindsight-template-test-fixture.ts — test-only actual authenticated Core registry/service/operation owner and persisted Bank reads; deterministic Native evidence and synthetic runtime/sync remain explicit.
- storage-card.tsx — media.usage display + the two-step attachment purge; confirmation and Cancel lock once clearing starts (outcomes ride FeedbackLine)
- use-operations.ts — the page's ws touchpoint: memory.tidy plus the cached memory.status / media.usage reads (a failed re-read keeps the last counters on screen; refresh() backs the retry)
- use-media-clear.ts — destructive purge owner: immediate exact-once guard, media.clear call, terminal release, and refresh
- operations-state.ts — pure view models + media.clear state machine; Cancel is valid only before destructive execution
- memory-authority-card.tsx — memory.authority.status card: authority/runtime/setup lines, the Hindsight lifecycle and backup blocks, per-Bank replica + Pending rows with Sync now / Full reconcile / Retry, active operations with Cancel (admitted replica.sync only)
- memory-authority-state.ts — pure card view models and shared Bank/operation/runtime labels, including template operations and durable holds; unknown stays unknown and refusals remain Core-owned
- memory-hindsight-lifecycle-block.tsx — the card's Hindsight connection + Bank readiness block: 重新校验连接 / 创建 Bank buttons through the generic submit, collapsed diagnostics
- memory-hindsight-lifecycle-state.ts — pure projection of the status `hindsight` section: connection rows, per-scope readiness rows, diagnostics (native ids, error codes) and action descriptors from Core `actions` only
- memory-hindsight-backup-block.tsx — the card's Hindsight backup block: rollback warning, state / age / per-Bank missing interval, in-flight or failure line, route-b 导入备份 form, 创建备份 / 校验备份 through the generic submit, collapsed 备份诊断
- memory-hindsight-backup-state.ts — pure projection of `hindsight.backup` plus the backup.* operation rows: closed-code messages including missing/unpublished template evidence, explicit unknown remote-only writes, the newest staged route-b capture and the unverified newest backup from the section, action descriptors (校验备份 targets the newest sealed backup) and the inbox-validated admit request; the only client rule is disabling while a backup operation is open
- memory-hindsight-backup-fixtures.ts — test support (not in the production path): one MemoryAuthorityStatus per backup block state plus backup.* operation rows
- memory-operations-controller.ts — framework-free guard shared by the Stage 1 and Hindsight cards: one injected status read per instance behind the changed-push subscription, generic serialized submit(request, key)/cancel, coalesced refetch on push and after every mutation outcome, injected subscription/mutation error formatting, no replay
- use-memory-operations.ts — the React seam for memory.authority.status + memory.operations.*: state + the controller lifecycle bound to the authenticated client, generic submit / submitSync / cancel
- memory-transition-state.ts — contextual closed Chinese refusal/Native phase labels, one confirmed request and separate authority/runtime/queue facts; no permission derivation.
- memory-transitions-controller.ts — disposable preview generation and consumed request identity over the existing operation subscription/mutation controller; never replays after replacement.
- use-memory-transitions.ts — Home-client-bound transition hook with last-good status and explicit preview/confirm/recovery/cancel actions.
- memory-transitions-card.tsx — current authority/actions, inline confirmation and bounded durable history under every provider/runtime state.
- memory-transition-confirmation.tsx — one healthy confirmation or separate emergency confirmation with cancel focus and Escape restoration.
- memory-transition-disclosure.tsx — nullable surviving Bank evidence, backup age and explicitly unknown remote loss.
- memory-transition-progress.tsx — original operation facts, separate commit/runtime/queue outcomes, Core-permitted recovery/cancel and diagnostics.
- memory-authority-fixtures.ts — test support (not in the production path): MemoryAuthorityStatus / Bank / MemoryOperation fixtures plus the Hindsight lifecycle section (every readiness state) shared by the card, view-model and controller tests
- local-onboarding-card.tsx — memory.onboarding.status card: authority/runtime facts including template holds, progress, Core-derived actions, exceptions and diagnostics
- local-onboarding-exceptions.tsx — bounded source diagnostics with the per-source exclusion reason form and cursor paging
- local-onboarding-actions.ts — action labels, Core-derived allow checks and the exact memory.operations.submit request per action
- local-onboarding-state.ts — LocalOnboardingState + pure headline/progress/refusal presentation (unknown stays unknown)
- local-onboarding-controller.ts — framework-free guard: subscribe-before-read, generation/version-guarded reads, coalesced invalidations, serialized actions, no replay
- use-local-onboarding.ts — the React seam for memory.onboarding.*: controller lifecycle bound to the authenticated client and page visibility
- local-onboarding-fixtures.ts — test support (not in the production path): MemoryOnboardingStatus fixtures shared by the card and controller tests
- hindsight-activation-card.tsx — memory.activation.status card: setup phase, Bank prerequisites with missing/extra scopes, run/producer progress (admitted vs completed distinct), 校验连接 / 应用配置 / 启用 Hindsight / 继续 / 恢复运行时 / 取消, technical diagnostics
- hindsight-activation-state.ts — HindsightActivationState + pure headline/guidance/facts/Bank rows/blocking lines/diagnostics (unknown stays 未知, ids and hashes only in diagnostics)
- hindsight-activation-actions.ts — action labels, allow checks (Core-derived actions plus the setup kinds while unconfigured), the exact submit request per action and the dispatch through the generic controller
- use-hindsight-activation.ts — the React seam for memory.activation.status: the generic controller bound to the authenticated client and page visibility (hidden retires the generation)
- hindsight-activation-fixtures.ts — test support (not in the production path): one MemoryActivationStatus fixture per card state shared by the card, view-model and dispatch tests
